evidence.quote: Nvidia , Microsoft , Meta , Palantir and more than 20 other companies released a letter Friday urging policymakers to avoid "premature restrictions" on open-weight artificial intelligence models that would "stifle competition or drive innovation overseas."
evidence.one_line: Nvidia, Microsoft, Meta, Palantir and 20+ others released a letter Friday urging policymakers to avoid premature restrictions on open-weight AI models.
evidence.speaker: Nvidia, Microsoft, Meta, Palantir and other signatories

evidence.quote: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC on Tuesday that the Trump administration would look into whether Chinese companies were stealing American intellectual property, and stated that the government has "the ability to sanction them because of this theft."
evidence.one_line: Treasury Secretary Bessent said the administration would look into whether Chinese companies were stealing US IP and that the government could sanction them.
evidence.speaker: Scott Bessent

evidence.quote: White House advisor Michael Kratsios on Wednesday said that China's Moonshot AI developed its Kimi K3 model by distilling Anthropic's technology.
evidence.one_line: White House advisor Kratsios said Moonshot AI developed Kimi K3 by distilling Anthropic's technology.
evidence.speaker: Michael Kratsios

evidence.quote: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella both shared the letter on their personal social media accounts.
evidence.one_line: Jensen Huang and Satya Nadella shared the letter on their personal social media accounts.
evidence.speaker: Jensen Huang and Satya Nadella

evidence.quote: OpenAI and Anthropic did not sign the letter. Both companies, which are each valued at nearly $1 trillion, are gearing up for potentially massive initial public offerings that could land as soon as this year. Anthropic confidentially filed its prospectus with the Securities and Exchange Commission in June, and OpenAI followed suit days later.
evidence.one_line: OpenAI and Anthropic did not sign the letter; Anthropic confidentially filed its IPO prospectus with the SEC in June, and OpenAI followed days later.
evidence.speaker: CNBC reporting
